decisions.reason: The coolant pressure booster extends the firm's core coolant management offer, which the firm has publicly committed to, and it has stayed on the website through 2024, so management will keep investing in it rather than write off the development effort.

The cleaning centrifuge supports the announced direction of sustainable, efficient coolant filtration and is still visibly marketed, so any weak early sales are easily blamed on a slow market and the product is kept.

The scraper belt chip conveyor sits close to the firm's established conveyor business, so it carries low incremental cost and high strategic centrality, and dropping it would contradict the firm's core identity.
The hinged belt conveyor is a staple of the firm's chip conveying portfolio, and its continued website presence signals ongoing commitment, so management will persist with it.
